description: This file provides a wrapper class for interacting with Google's Gemini API, including configuration, message handling, and response generation for an AI assistant. It manages API keys, initializes the model, and exposes methods for generating replies based on conversation history.

classes.name: GeminiService
classes.description: Service class for configuring and interacting with Google's Gemini AI API, providing methods to generate responses and check configuration status.

methods.name: __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the GeminiService by reading API key from environment, configuring the API, and setting the model.

methods.name: str generate_reply( self, history: List[Dict[str, str]], user_message: str )
methods.description: Generates an AI response based on conversation history and a new user message.

methods.name: bool is_configured(self)
methods.description: Checks if the GeminiService has been properly configured with an API key.
